title: Multimodality detection of early relapse in radically treated high-risk HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: study protocol for a prospective multicentre UK cohort study (HERD).
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is the seventh most common cancer globally, with over 12 000 new cases annually in the UK. Despite aggressive radical treatment, approximately 50% of patients with locally advanced (stage III/IV), human papilloma virus (HPV)-negative disease relapse within 2 years, often in the first year. Although current post-treatment follow-up schedules are recommended by clinical guidelines, imaging surveillance is led by symptoms after the initial 3 months and reliable biomarkers for early relapse are lacking. Consequently, recurrences are frequently detected too late for surgical salvage, though timely surgery can improve survival by up to 73% in selected cases. Head and Neck Early Relapse Detection Study represents a large-scale, prospective effort to integrate imaging, genomic, immunologic and microbiome datasets for relapse risk stratification and post-treatment surveillance in this high-risk patient group. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: Design: Prospective, observational cohort study. SETTING: Secondary and tertiary NHS hospitals in the UK. PARTICIPANTS: Recruiting up to 200 patients with stage III/IV (high-risk) HPV-negative HNSCC. Participants are enrolled into discovery (n=100) and validation (n=100) cohorts. Patients with HPV-positive tumours, metastatic disease or other contraindications defined in the protocol will be excluded. INTERVENTIONS: Observational study with no experimental intervention. Participants are followed for 2 years with longitudinal collection of blood, saliva, urine, stool, fresh and archival tumour tissue and advanced MRI where possible in addition to their standard of clinical care. PRIMARY OUTCOMES: Development and independent validation of a multimodal recurrence risk prediction model. SECONDARY OUTCOMES: Identifying patient populations for primary treatment stratification, establishment of a longitudinal biorepository and identifying biological mechanisms of recurrence. Multimodal data will be integrated using machine learning and Bayesian modelling. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: Ethical approval was granted by the Bromley Research Ethics Committee (21/PR/1581). Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and scientific meetings. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05097625.

abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 头颈鳞状细胞癌(HNSCC)是全球第七常见的癌症,每年在英国约有超过12,000例新发病例。尽管采用积极的 radical 治疗 治疗,约50%的局部晚期(III/IV期)人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)阴性患者在2年内复发,通常在第一年内。虽然目前的 post-治疗 随访计划已被临床指南推荐,但影像学 监测 主要依赖于症状在初始3个月后进行,且缺乏可靠的早期复发生物标志物。因此,复发常被发现得太晚,无法进行手术挽救,尽管在某些情况下及时手术可将生存率提高多达73%。Head and Neck Early Relapse Detection Study 是一项大规模的前瞻性研究,旨在整合影像学、基因组学、免疫学和微生物组数据集,以对这一高风险患者群体进行复发风险分层和 post-治疗 监测。METHODS AND ANALYSIS: 设计:前瞻性、观察性 队列研究 研究。SETTING: 英国的二级和三级 NHS 医院。PARTICIPANTS: 招募最多200名 III/IV期(高风险)HPV 阴性 HNSCC 患者。参与者将被纳入发现组(n=100)和验证组(n=100)。患有 HPV 阳性肿瘤、转移性疾病或其他在方案中定义的禁忌症的患者将被排除。INTERVENTIONS: 观察性研究,无实验干预。参与者将在2年内接受随访,纵向收集血液、唾液、尿液、粪便、新鲜和存档肿瘤组织以及尽可能进行的先进MRI,同时继续其标准临床护理。PRIMARY OUTCOMES: 开发并独立验证多模态复发风险预测模型。SECONDARY OUTCOMES: 识别用于 primary 治疗 分层的患者群体,建立纵向生物样本库,并确定复发的生物学机制。多模态数据将通过机器学习和贝叶斯建模进行整合。ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: 伦理批准由 Bromley 研究伦理委员会(21/PR/1581)授予。研究结果将通过同行评审的出版物、会议报告和科学会议进行传播。TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05097625.

title: Predicting parental Human papillomavirus vaccine hesitancy: development and internal validation of machine learning models
abstract: Abstract Objectives Cervical cancer is Cameroon’s second most common cancer among women. However, high parental Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy impedes elimination, and no validated predictive tool exists. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District and identify key predictors. Methods This secondary analysis used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years. Hesitancy was derived from self-reported vaccination status and intention. Twenty-six predictor groups were screened via group LASSO (17 retained for logistic regression; all 26 for tree-based models). Data were split 80/20 into training (n=925) and test (n=231) sets. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were tuned via repeated cross-validation while thresholds were set by Youden’s J statistic. Discrimination, calibration, and Brier score were assessed on the test set. Predictions were interpreted using SHAP. Results All models showed comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870). XGBoost had the highest AUC (0.870, vs 0.869 for logistic regression, DeLong p=0.965); logistic regression had the highest sensitivity (73.1%), F1-score (74.9%), and lowest Brier score (0.1435). Calibration slopes exceeded 1 (1.12–1.46) across models. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors. Discussion The three models achieved comparable, clinically meaningful discrimination, and algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression. Hesitancy was more strongly predicted by information access and institutional trust than sociodemographic disadvantage. Conclusion These findings support trust-building engagement over broad demographic campaigns. What is already known on this topic Parental HPV vaccine hesitancy is a major barrier to HPV vaccination, but predictive modelling evidence from sub-Saharan Africa is limited and no internally validated model for parental HPV vaccine hesitancy has been developed in the region. What this study adds We developed and internally validated logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost models for predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy, with all three showing comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870) and logistic regression achieving the lowest Brier score and highest sensitivity and F1-score. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors across the models and interpretability analyses. How this study might affect research, practice or policy The findings support the development and external validation of simple, interpretable prediction tools to identify parents who may benefit from targeted, trust-building vaccine communication and community engagement to support HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models to predict parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District. The researchers used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years, screening 26 predictor groups and tuning three models: logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. All models showed comparable discrimination, with XGBoost achieving the highest AUC and logistic regression showing the highest sensitivity and F1-score. The dominant predictors of hesitancy were insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health. The findings suggest the potential for developing simple, interpretable prediction tools to support targeted communication and community engagement for HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention. However, the study found that algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression, indicating that simpler models may be sufficient. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study's design and the absence of external validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种是喀麦隆女性中第二常见的癌症。然而,高程度的父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫阻碍了消除进程,且目前尚无经过验证的预测工具。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在开发并内部验证用于预测Buea卫生区父母对HPV疫苗接种犹豫的机器学习模型,并确定关键预测因素。数据按80/20的比例分为训练集(n=925)和测试集(n=231)。
elements_zh.methods: 方法 本研究采用二次分析方法,使用了来自1,156名9至18岁儿童父母的横断面调查数据。通过组LASSO筛选了26个预测组(17个用于逻辑回归;26个用于树模型)。逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型通过重复交叉验证进行调优,阈值由Youden’s J统计量设定。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 所有模型的区分度均相当(AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870)。XGBoost的AUC最高(0.870,与逻辑回归的0.869相比,DeLong p=0.965);逻辑回归的敏感度最高(73.1%),F1分数最高(74.9%),且Brier分数最低(0.1435)。所有模型的校准斜率均超过1(1.12–1.46)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 犹豫程度更强烈地由信息获取和机构信任预测,而非社会人口学劣势。信息不足、对HPV疫苗接种的安全性感知不足以及对卫生部的不信任是所有模型和可解释性分析中的主要预测因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持开发和外部验证简单且可解释的预测工具,以识别可能从有针对性的信任建立HPV疫苗接种沟通和社区参与中受益的父母,从而支持HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌预防。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 三种模型均实现了相当且具有临床意义的区分度,算法复杂性并未在标准回归之上提高预测能力。

abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种是喀麦隆女性中第二常见的癌症。然而,高程度的父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫阻碍了消除进程,且目前尚无经过验证的预测工具。本研究旨在开发并内部验证用于预测Buea卫生区父母对HPV疫苗接种犹豫的机器学习模型,并确定关键预测因素。方法 本研究采用二次分析方法,使用了来自1,156名9至18岁儿童父母的横断面调查数据。犹豫程度来源于自我报告的疫苗接种状态和意愿。通过组LASSO筛选了26个预测组(17个用于逻辑回归;26个用于树模型)。数据按80/20的比例分为训练集(n=925)和测试集(n=231)。逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型通过重复交叉验证进行调优,阈值由Youden’s J统计量设定。在测试集上评估了模型的区分度、校准度和Brier分数。使用SHAP对预测结果进行了解释。结果 所有模型的区分度均相当(AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870)。XGBoost的AUC最高(0.870,与逻辑回归的0.869相比,DeLong p=0.965);逻辑回归的敏感度最高(73.1%),F1分数最高(74.9%),且Brier分数最低(0.1435)。所有模型的校准斜率均超过1(1.12–1.46)。信息不足、对HPV疫苗接种的安全性感知不足以及对卫生部的不信任是主要的预测因素。讨论 三种模型均实现了相当且具有临床意义的区分度,算法复杂性并未在标准回归之上提高预测能力。犹豫程度更强烈地由信息获取和机构信任预测,而非社会人口学劣势。结论 这些发现支持通过建立信任的参与方式,而非广泛的人口学宣传活动,来应对父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫。已有知识 由于父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫是HPV疫苗接种的主要障碍,但撒哈拉以南非洲地区的预测建模证据有限,且该地区尚未开发出内部验证的父母对HPV疫苗接种犹豫预测模型。本研究的贡献 我们开发并内部验证了逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型,用于预测父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫。所有三种模型均显示出相当的区分度(AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870),其中逻辑回归实现了最低的Brier分数和最高的敏感度及F1分数。信息不足、对HPV疫苗接种的安全性感知不足以及对卫生部的不信任是所有模型和可解释性分析中的主要预测因素。对研究、实践或政策的潜在影响 这些发现支持开发和外部验证简单且可解释的预测工具,以识别可能从有针对性的信任建立HPV疫苗接种沟通和社区参与中受益的父母,从而支持HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌预防。

title: Retrospective Study of Wandai Decoction Plus Recombinant Human Interferon Alpha-2b in Persistent High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Infection.
abstract: This retrospective study evaluated clinical outcomes associated with Wandai Decoction (WDT) plus recombinant human interferon α-2b (rhIFN-α-2b) in patients with persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection and a spleen-deficiency pattern, with particular attention to vaginal microecology and peripheral T-cell subsets. Clinical data from 125 patients treated between March 2024 and September 2025 were analyzed. According to the treatment regimen, 57 patients received oral WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b vaginal suppositories, whereas 68 patients received rhIFN-α-2b alone. Both groups received three consecutive treatment courses. After treatment, the observation group had a higher total effective rate than the control group (89.47% vs. 72.06%, p = 0.015) and a shorter time to first HPV conversion (P = 0.028), whereas the overall four-category HPV outcome distribution (P = 0.060) and HPV16/18-specific conversion rate (P = 0.138) did not differ significantly. More favorable vaginal microecological findings included lower pH, leukocyte esterase positivity, and amine test positivity, along with higher rates of normal hydrogen peroxide status, vaginal cleanliness grade I-II, and Lactobacillus predominance (P < 0.05). Fungal detection, bacterial vaginosis-related abnormalities, and mixed infection were also less frequent (P < 0.05). Post-treatment CD4+ T-cell percentage and the CD4+/CD8+ ratio were higher, whereas CD8+ T-cell percentage was lower, in the observation group (P < 0.05). The total traditional Chinese medicine syndrome score, abnormal cervical color, and contact bleeding also showed more favorable findings. The overall rate of recorded adverse events did not differ significantly between groups (P = 0.057). WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b was associated with more favorable HPV-related, vaginal microecological, peripheral T-cell subset, and symptom outcomes; however, the retrospective design and residual confounding preclude causal interpretation.

title: Global policy determinants of national human papillomavirus vaccine introductions in 2006-2025.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although safe and effective human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines have been available since 2006, national introduction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) has progressed slowly. HPV vaccine adoption may have been shaped by evolving World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations, funding policies of Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, and the disruption from the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic. However, their relative contributions have not been quantified. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: This study analyzed policy determinants of national HPV vaccine introduction rate in LMICs from 2006 to 2025, using: (i) generalized linear model (GLM) to assess predetermined policy events, and (ii) changepoint analysis to identify shifts in adoption trends. RESULTS: Across a range of GLMs exploring different events and outcome variables, WHO's one-dose recommendation in 2022 was most strongly associated with an increase in country introductions, with the expansion of Gavi's funding policy for HPV vaccines (2017-2025) also important in some models. Comparing model projections with and without the one-dose schedule yielded an estimated 22.46 additional national HPV vaccine introductions in LMICs. Changepoint analysis identified a significant increase in introductions in 2022. CONCLUSIONS: These results quantify the primary global drivers of HPV vaccine uptake, offering actionable insights for expanding equitable vaccine access.

HPV vaccine adoption may have been shaped by evolving World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations, funding policies of Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, and the disruption from the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study analyzed policy determinants of national HPV vaccine introduction rate in LMICs from 2006 to 2025.
analysis.methods: This study used generalized linear model (GLM) to assess predetermined policy events and changepoint analysis to identify shifts in adoption trends.
analysis.main_results: Across a range of GLMs exploring different events and outcome variables, WHO's one-dose recommendation in 2022 was most strongly associated with an increase in country introductions, with the expansion of Gavi's funding policy for HPV vaccines (2017-2025) also important in some models. Comparing model projections with and without the one-dose schedule yielded an estimated 22.46 additional national HPV vaccine introductions in LMICs. Changepoint analysis identified a significant increase in introductions in 2022.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These results quantify the primary global drivers of HPV vaccine uptake, offering actionable insights for expanding equitable vaccine access.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer actionable insights for expanding equitable vaccine access and inform strategies to accelerate HPV vaccine introduction in LMICs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not report limitations, but the evidence is based on model projections and changepoint analysis, which may have inherent uncertainties.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the policy determinants influencing the national introduction of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) from 2006 to 2025. It highlights that WHO's one-dose recommendation in 2022 was most strongly associated with increased vaccine introductions, while Gavi's funding policy expansion (2017-2025) also played a role in some models. Changepoint analysis identified a significant increase in introductions in 2022, with model projections estimating 22.46 additional national introductions. The study provides actionable insights for improving equitable vaccine access, though it does not explicitly report limitations. The evidence is based on statistical modeling and changepoint analysis, which may introduce some uncertainty.

title_zh: 2006-2025年间全球政策对低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗引进的影响
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Although safe and effective human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines have been available since 2006, national introduction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) has progressed slowly. HPV vaccine adoption may have been shaped by evolving World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations, funding policies of Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, and the disruption from the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic. However, their relative contributions have not been quantified. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: This study analyzed policy determinants of national HPV vaccine introduction rate in LMICs from 2006 to 2025, using: (i) generalized linear model (GLM) to assess predetermined policy events, and (ii) changepoint analysis to identify shifts in adoption trends. RESULTS: Across a range of GLMs exploring different events and outcome variables, WHO's one-dose recommendation in 2022 was most strongly associated with an increase in country introductions, with the expansion of Gavi's funding policy for HPV vaccines (2017-2025) also important in some models. Comparing model projections with and without the one-dose schedule yielded an estimated 22.46 additional national HPV vaccine introductions in LMICs. Changepoint analysis identified a significant increase in introductions in 2022. CONCLUSIONS: These results quantify the primary global drivers of HPV vaccine uptake, offering actionable insights for expanding equitable vaccine access.
abstract_zh: 背景:尽管安全有效的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗自2006年起已可获得,但低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)的国家引进进展缓慢。HPV 疫苗的采用可能受到世界卫生组织(WHO)不断变化的建议、Gavi疫苗联盟的资助政策以及2019冠状病毒病(COVID-19)大流行带来的干扰的影响。然而,这些因素的相对贡献尚未量化。研究设计与方法:本研究分析了2006年至2025年间LMICs国家HPV 疫苗引进率的政策决定因素,采用:(i)广义线性模型(GLM)评估预定政策事件,(ii)变化点分析以识别采用趋势的转变。结果:在一系列探讨不同事件和结果变量的GLM中,WHO于2022年提出的单剂接种建议与国家引进数量的增加最为相关,而Gavi对HPV 疫苗的资助政策扩展(2017-2025)在某些模型中也具有重要意义。将包含和不包含单剂接种计划的模型预测进行比较,估计在LMICs中额外有22.46个国家引进了HPV 疫苗。变化点分析发现2022年引进数量显著增加。结论:这些结果量化了HPV 疫苗全球采用的主要驱动因素,为扩大公平的疫苗可及性提供了可操作的见解。

title: The Vaginal Microbiome Across the Continuum from HPV Infection to Cervical Cancer: A Narrative Review
abstract: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection serves as the core prerequisite for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) and invasive cervical cancer. Accumulated translational evidence confirms that vaginal microecological homeostasis dominated by protective Lactobacillus strains fundamentally governs the initiation, persistence, and spontaneous clearance of HR-HPV infection, while microbial dysbiosis featuring depleted lactobacilli and overgrown anaerobic pathogens creates a pro-inflammatory, immune-suppressive mucosal niche that accelerates viral retention and cervical malignant transformation. We conducted a narrative review of studies published primarily between January 2021 and April 2026. PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP were searched using terms related to the vaginal microbiome, HR-HPV infection, CIN, cervical cancer, underlying mechanisms, microbial biomarkers, and microbiome-modulating interventions. Relevant peer-reviewed epidemiological, mechanistic, and clinical studies were prioritized, and the manuscript was prepared with reference to the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA). This review systematically delineates the bidirectional regulatory crosstalk between vaginal microbiota and HR-HPV across the cervical cancer continuum. Dysbiosis disrupts vaginal acidic barriers, reshapes local cytokine networks, impairs antiviral innate immunity, and modulates HPV E6/E7 oncogenic transcription; reciprocally, HR-HPV oncoproteins remodel microbial community structures to sustain a dysbiotic feedback loop. Three core carcinogenic cascades induced by dysbiotic flora are elaborated: epithelial barrier erosion, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic rewiring of host and viral genomes. Dynamic microbial characteristics corresponding to all stages of progressive cervical lesions, from transient HPV infection to high-grade CIN and carcinoma, are sorted out. The bench-to-bedside translational progress of microbiome-targeted interventions is summarized, including single/multi-strain probiotic supplementation, engineered lactic acid bacterial therapeutic vaccines, vaginal microbiota transplantation, and traditional Chinese medicine therapy that reconstructs vaginal eubiosis. The clinical application of microbial diversity, strain-level single-nucleotide variants, and taxonomic biomarkers for early screening, efficacy prediction, and postoperative recurrence risk stratification is illustrated. This comprehensive framework with the vaginal microbiome as the core clarifies the internal mechanism of HR-HPV progression along the entire pathway to cervical cancer and provides practical clinical means to block this cascade. Current bottlenecks, including inconsistent probiotic standards, preclinical model limitations, and unresolved gut–vagina microbiome interactions, require further investigation before widespread clinical translation.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review explores the bidirectional relationship between the vaginal microbiome and high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) across the cervical cancer continuum. It highlights how microbial dysbiosis, characterized by depleted lactobacilli and overgrown anaerobic pathogens, creates a pro-inflammatory, immune-suppressive environment that promotes HR-HPV persistence and malignant transformation. The review outlines three core carcinogenic cascades: epithelial barrier erosion, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic rewiring. It also summarizes the translational progress of microbiome-targeted interventions, such as probiotics, therapeutic vaccines, and microbiota transplantation, and discusses their potential in early screening and risk stratification. Despite these insights, challenges like inconsistent probiotic standards, preclinical model limitations, and unresolved gut–vagina microbiome interactions remain, necessitating further research for clinical application.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 持续的高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染是宫颈上皮内瘤变(CIN)和侵袭性宫颈癌的核心前提。本综述探讨了在整个宫颈癌连续谱中阴道微生物群与HR-HPV之间的双向调控相互作用,重点分析了微生物失调、其对病毒感染的影响以及向宫颈癌发展的过程。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们对2021年1月至2026年4月期间发表的主要研究进行了叙述性综述。通过PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、万方数据和VIP数据库,使用与阴道微生物群、HR-HPV感染、CIN、宫颈癌、潜在机制、微生物生物标志物以及微生物群调节干预相关的关键词进行检索。优先选取了相关的同行评审流行病学、机制和临床研究,并参考了叙述性综述文章评估量表(SANRA)撰写本文。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 微生物失调会破坏阴道酸性屏障,重塑局部细胞因子网络,损害抗病毒药物固有免疫,并调节HPV E6/E7致癌转录;反之,HR-HPV致癌蛋白则重塑微生物群落结构,维持一种失调的反馈循环。详细阐述了由失调微生物群引发的三种核心致癌级联反应:上皮屏障侵蚀、代谢重编程以及宿主和病毒基因组的表观遗传重排。梳理了与宫颈病变进展所有阶段相关的动态微生物特征,从短暂的HPV感染到高级别CIN和癌变。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 当前的瓶颈包括益生菌标准不一致、临床前模型的局限性以及未解决的肠道-阴道微生物群相互作用,这些都需要在广泛临床转化之前进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 总结了针对微生物群的干预措施从实验室到临床的转化进展,包括单株/多株益生菌补充、工程化乳酸菌治疗疫苗、阴道微生物群移植以及能够重建阴道生态平衡的传统中医药疗法。展示了微生物多样性、菌株水平单核苷酸变异和分类学生物标志物在早期筛查、疗效预测和术后复发风险分层中的临床应用。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection serves as the core prerequisite for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) and invasive cervical cancer. This review explores the bidirectional regulatory crosstalk between vaginal microbiota and HR-HPV across the cervical cancer continuum, focusing on microbial dysbiosis, its impact on viral infection, and the progression to cervical cancer.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: We conducted a narrative review of studies published primarily between January 2021 and April 2026. PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP were searched using terms related to the vaginal microbiome, HR-HPV infection, CIN, cervical cancer, underlying mechanisms, microbial biomarkers, and microbiome-modulating interventions. Relevant peer-reviewed epidemiological, mechanistic, and clinical studies were prioritized, and the manuscript was prepared with reference to the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA).
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Dysbiosis disrupts vaginal acidic barriers, reshapes local cytokine networks, impairs antiviral innate immunity, and modulates HPV E6/E7 oncogenic transcription; reciprocally, HR-HPV oncoproteins remodel microbial community structures to sustain a dysbiotic feedback loop. Three core carcinogenic cascades induced by dysbiotic flora are elaborated: epithelial barrier erosion, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic rewiring of host and viral genomes. Dynamic microbial characteristics corresponding to all stages of progressive cervical lesions, from transient HPV infection to high-grade CIN and carcinoma, are sorted out.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Current bottlenecks, including inconsistent probiotic standards, preclinical model limitations, and unresolved gut–vagina microbiome interactions, require further investigation before widespread clinical translation.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The bench-to-bedside translational progress of microbiome-targeted interventions is summarized, including single/multi-strain probiotic supplementation, engineered lactic acid bacterial therapeutic vaccines, vaginal microbiota transplantation, and traditional Chinese medicine therapy that reconstructs vaginal eubiosis. The clinical application of microbial diversity, strain-level single-nucleotide variants, and taxonomic biomarkers for early screening, efficacy prediction, and postoperative recurrence risk stratification is illustrated.

title_zh: 从HPV感染到宫颈癌的整个连续谱中阴道微生物群:一篇叙述性综述
source_body_en: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection serves as the core prerequisite for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) and invasive cervical cancer. Accumulated translational evidence confirms that vaginal microecological homeostasis dominated by protective Lactobacillus strains fundamentally governs the initiation, persistence, and spontaneous clearance of HR-HPV infection, while microbial dysbiosis featuring depleted lactobacilli and overgrown anaerobic pathogens creates a pro-inflammatory, immune-suppressive mucosal niche that accelerates viral retention and cervical malignant transformation. We conducted a narrative review of studies published primarily between January 2021 and April 2026. PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP were searched using terms related to the vaginal microbiome, HR-HPV infection, CIN, cervical cancer, underlying mechanisms, microbial biomarkers, and microbiome-modulating interventions. Relevant peer-reviewed epidemiological, mechanistic, and clinical studies were prioritized, and the manuscript was prepared with reference to the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA). This review systematically delineates the bidirectional regulatory crosstalk between vaginal microbiota and HR-HPV across the cervical cancer continuum. Dysbiosis disrupts vaginal acidic barriers, reshapes local cytokine networks, impairs antiviral innate immunity, and modulates HPV E6/E7 oncogenic transcription; reciprocally, HR-HPV oncoproteins remodel microbial community structures to sustain a dysbiotic feedback loop. Three core carcinogenic cascades induced by dysbiotic flora are elaborated: epithelial barrier erosion, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic rewiring of host and viral genomes. Dynamic microbial characteristics corresponding to all stages of progressive cervical lesions, from transient HPV infection to high-grade CIN and carcinoma, are sorted out. The bench-to-bedside translational progress of microbiome-targeted interventions is summarized, including single/multi-strain probiotic supplementation, engineered lactic acid bacterial therapeutic vaccines, vaginal microbiota transplantation, and traditional Chinese medicine therapy that reconstructs vaginal eubiosis. The clinical application of microbial diversity, strain-level single-nucleotide variants, and taxonomic biomarkers for early screening, efficacy prediction, and postoperative recurrence risk stratification is illustrated. This comprehensive framework with the vaginal microbiome as the core clarifies the internal mechanism of HR-HPV progression along the entire pathway to cervical cancer and provides practical clinical means to block this cascade. Current bottlenecks, including inconsistent probiotic standards, preclinical model limitations, and unresolved gut–vagina microbiome interactions, require further investigation before widespread clinical translation.
abstract_zh: 持续的高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染是宫颈上皮内瘤变(CIN)和侵袭性宫颈癌的核心前提。积累的转化证据证实,以保护性乳酸杆菌为主的阴道微生态平衡从根本上调控HR-HPV感染的启动、持续和自发清除,而以乳酸杆菌减少和厌氧病原体过度增殖为特征的微生物失调则会创造一个促炎、免疫抑制的黏膜微环境,加速病毒滞留和宫颈恶性转化。我们对2021年1月至2026年4月期间发表的主要研究进行了叙述性综述。通过PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、万方数据和VIP数据库,使用与阴道微生物群、HR-HPV感染、CIN、宫颈癌、潜在机制、微生物生物标志物以及微生物群调节干预相关的关键词进行检索。优先选取了相关的同行评审流行病学、机制和临床研究,并参考了叙述性综述文章评估量表(SANRA)撰写本文。本综述系统阐述了在整个宫颈癌连续谱中阴道微生物群与HR-HPV之间的双向调控相互作用。微生物失调会破坏阴道酸性屏障,重塑局部细胞因子网络,损害抗病毒药物固有免疫,并调节HPV E6/E7致癌转录;反之,HR-HPV致癌蛋白则重塑微生物群落结构,维持一种失调的反馈循环。详细阐述了由失调微生物群引发的三种核心致癌级联反应:上皮屏障侵蚀、代谢重编程以及宿主和病毒基因组的表观遗传重排。梳理了与宫颈病变进展所有阶段相关的动态微生物特征,从短暂的HPV感染到高级别CIN和癌变。总结了针对微生物群的干预措施从实验室到临床的转化进展,包括单株/多株益生菌补充、工程化乳酸菌治疗疫苗、阴道微生物群移植以及能够重建阴道生态平衡的传统中医药疗法。展示了微生物多样性、菌株水平单核苷酸变异和分类学生物标志物在早期筛查、疗效预测和术后复发风险分层中的临床应用。以阴道微生物群为核心,这一全面框架阐明了HR-HPV沿整个路径至宫颈癌的进展内部机制,并提供了阻断这一级联反应的实用临床手段。当前的瓶颈包括益生菌标准不一致、临床前模型的局限性以及未解决的肠道-阴道微生物群相互作用,这些都需要在广泛临床转化之前进一步研究。

title: Contemporary global prevalence and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus among female sex workers, 2015–2025: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: Abstract Background Female sex workers experience disproportionate exposure to human papillomavirus (HPV), but estimates of HPV prevalence and genotype distribution vary according to geography, specimen type, diagnostic method, and genotype coverage. This updated systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized contemporary evidence published between February 2015 and December 2025. Methods PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were systematically searched without language restrictions. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and critically appraised included studies using the JBI checklist for prevalence studies. One independent estimate was retained per study population for the primary analysis to avoid double-counting. Overall and type-specific HPV prevalence estimates were synthesized using random-effects generalized linear mixed models with logit transformation. Heterogeneity, prediction intervals, subgroup patterns, and sensitivity analyses were examined. The review was not prospectively registered. Results Thirty-six independent study/population estimates from 23 countries included 12,193 female sex workers, of whom 5,586 were HPV positive. The pooled HPV prevalence was 39.0% (95% confidence interval, 30.0%-48.9%), with very high heterogeneity (I2=97.6%) and a wide prediction interval (5.0%-88.6%). Prevalence varied across World Bank geographic regions, country income groups, diagnostic methods, and specimen types. Among genotypes assessed in at least 10 studies, HPV-52 had the highest pooled prevalence, followed by HPV-53 and HPV-16; HPV-58, HPV-35, and HPV-66 each had a pooled prevalence of 5.8%. Sensitivity analyses did not materially change the overall interpretation. Conclusions The available contemporary evidence indicates a substantial overall burden of HPV among female sex workers, although prevalence varies markedly across populations and settings. The broad genotype distribution includes both vaccine-targeted and non-vaccine types and underscores the relevance of vaccination, cervical cancer screening, and integrated STI/HIV prevention services for this population.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 女性性工作者面临不成比例的HPV暴露风险,但HPV感染率和基因型分布的估计因地理区域、样本类型、诊断方法和基因型覆盖范围而异。本更新的系统综述和荟萃分析综合了2015年2月至2025年12月间发表的当代证据。方法 通过PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索,不限制语言。两名评审员独立筛选记录、提取数据,并使用JBI检查表对纳入研究进行批判性评价。为避免重复计数,每项研究人群保留一个独立的估计值。使用对数转换的随机效应广义线性混合模型综合总体和特定型别的HPV感染率估计值。分析了异质性、预测区间、亚组模式和敏感性分析。本综述未进行前瞻性注册。结果 从23个国家纳入了36个独立的研究/人群估计值,共包含12,193名女性性工作者,其中5,586名检测出HPV阳性。综合感染率为39.0%(95%置信区间,30.0%-48.9%),异质性非常高(I2=97.6%),预测区间较宽(5.0%-88.6%)。HPV感染率在世界银行地理区域、国家收入组别、诊断方法和样本类型之间存在显著差异。在至少有10项研究评估的基因型中,HPV-52的综合感染率最高,其次是HPV-53和HPV-16;HPV-58、HPV-35和HPV-66的综合感染率均为5.8%。敏感性分析未显著改变总体解释。结论 当前可用的证据表明,女性性工作者中HPV的总体负担相当大,尽管感染率在不同人群和环境中存在显著差异。广泛的基因型分布包括针对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的基因型和非人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的基因型,强调了针对该人群的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查、系统发育分析以及整合的性传播疾病(STI)/艾滋病病毒(HIV)预防服务的重要性。

title: Acceptability and preference of self-collected vaginal samples for human papillomavirus DNA testing compared with physician-collected Pap smear.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Self-collected vaginal sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing provides a promising alternative to physician-collected Pap smears, especially in low-resource settings. However, data on its acceptability and preferences among Filipino women remain limited. This study aimed to assess women's perceptions, experiences, willingness and preferences regarding self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing compared with Pap smears. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 592 women. Participants underwent both physician-collected Pap smears and self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing. Perceptions were measured using five-point Likert scale questionnaires before and after self-collection. Descriptive statistics were used, and paired and independent Wilcoxon tests were used to compare Likert responses. Willingness to undergo screening was analyzed with Cochran's Q and McNemar tests. Participants' reasons for their preferred screening method were categorized thematically and displayed in stacked bar charts. RESULTS: Self-collection was generally viewed as painless, not uncomfortable, non-embarrassing, and easy and convenient. Acceptability significantly increased after participants performed self-collection (P < 0.001 for pain and discomfort). Compared with Pap smears, self-collection was seen as less embarrassing (P < 0.001), but rated as less easy (P = 0.01) and less convenient (P = 0.004). Most participants preferred physician-administered screening (84.8%) due to trust in medical expertise, and confidence in the procedure's accuracy, safety and cleanliness. CONCLUSIONS: Self-collected vaginal sampling was highly acceptable, yet physician-collected screening remained the preferred method. Improving education, demonstrations, and support for self-collection may enhance the uptake of HPV DNA testing and broaden access to cervical cancer screening in the Philippines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)DNA检测为医生采集的巴氏涂片提供了一种有前景的替代方案,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中。然而,关于菲律宾女性对其可接受性和偏好的数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在592名女性中进行了一项横断面研究。参与者接受了医生采集的巴氏涂片和自我采集的阴道样本用于HPV DNA检测。
elements_zh.methods: 使用五点李克特量表问卷在自我采集前后测量感知。采用描述性统计分析,并使用配对和独立Wilcoxon检验比较李克特量表回答。使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析接受筛查的意愿。参与者偏好的筛查方法的原因被主题分类,并以堆叠条形图显示。
elements_zh.main_results: 自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为提高HPV DNA检测参与率和扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性提供策略依据,强调了对自我采集方法进行教育和支持的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和自我报告数据,这可能引入偏倚。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于可接受性和偏好的见解,但并未建立因果关系。

analysis_zh.main_results: 自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为提高HPV DNA检测参与率和扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性提供策略依据,强调了对自我采集方法进行教育和支持的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和自我报告数据,这可能引入偏倚。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于可接受性和偏好的见解,但并未建立因果关系。

title: Caregiver knowledge and Attitudes toward Human Papillomavirus Vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone: A health facility-based cross-sectional study
abstract: Objective: To assess the knowledge, willingness and barriers to human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination among caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Methods This cross-sectional study examined HPV vaccine knowledge, willingness, and barriers among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Data were collected through structured questionnaires at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, and associations were assessed using chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis analyses. Results Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, with even fewer aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods of cervical cancer (31.9%, 79/248). Misconceptions were prevalent; 16.3% (36/221) erroneously linked oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, and 61.1% (44/72) of caregivers unwilling to vaccinate cited distrust in vaccine efficacy. While tertiary-educated caregivers exhibited the highest level of knowledge (45.5%, p < 0.001), their willingness to vaccinate (50%, 33/66) was comparable to that of less-educated groups, highlighting a knowledge-action gap. Structural barriers dominated, with 66.1% (154/233) citing unawareness of the vaccine and 10.3% (24/233) missing school-based vaccination days. Relationship dynamics significantly influenced willingness: extended family members showed the highest willingness (69.4%, p = 0.029), whereas grandparents were least willing (31%, 9/29). Although systemic gaps such disrupted vaccination services, vaccines supplies and cold chain limited uptake, healthcare workers emerged as the most effective information source (rank sum = 889.5, p = 0.039). Conclusion The study highlights needs for culturally tailored education to dispel myths, community-driven strategies engaging trusted actors like healthcare workers and extended families.This study justifies the need for integration of HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening into HIV care services.

Methods This cross-sectional study examined HPV vaccine knowledge, willingness, and barriers among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Data were collected through structured questionnaires at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, and associations were assessed using chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis analyses. Results Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, with even fewer aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods of cervical cancer (31.9%, 79/248). Misconceptions were prevalent; 16.3% (36/221) erroneously linked oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, and 61.1% (44/72) of caregivers unwilling to vaccinate cited distrust in vaccine efficacy. While tertiary-educated caregivers exhibited the highest level of knowledge (45.5%, p < 0.001), their willingness to vaccinate (50%, 33/66) was comparable to that of less-educated groups, highlighting a knowledge-action gap. Structural barriers dominated, with 66.1% (154/233) citing unawareness of the vaccine and 10.3% (24/233) missing school-based vaccination days. Relationship dynamics significantly influenced willingness: extended family members showed the highest willingness (69.4%, p = 0.029), whereas grandparents were least willing (31%, 9/29). Although systemic gaps such disrupted vaccination services, vaccines supplies and cold chain limited uptake, healthcare workers emerged as the most effective information source (rank sum = 889.5, p = 0.039). Conclusion The study highlights needs for culturally tailored education to dispel myths, community-driven strategies engaging trusted actors like healthcare workers and extended families.This study justifies the need for integration of HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening into HIV care services.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate caregiver knowledge, willingness, and barriers to human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone, addressing the gap in understanding how these factors influence vaccination decisions in this specific population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A health facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone, focusing on their awareness and attitudes toward HPV vaccination.
analysis.methods: Structured questionnaires were used to collect data at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, with statistical analyses including chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis tests to assess associations.
analysis.main_results: Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, and fewer were aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods (31.9%, 79/248). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study reveals a significant knowledge-action gap, as tertiary-educated caregivers had the highest knowledge but similar willingness to vaccinate as less-educated groups, indicating that knowledge alone does not translate to action.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估塞拉利昂接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种的认知、意愿及其障碍,以填补对这些因素如何影响该特定人群疫苗接种决策的理解空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在塞拉利昂的249名接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者中进行,是一项基于医疗机构的横断面研究,重点考察他们对HPV疫苗接种的认知和态度。
elements_zh.methods: 通过结构化问卷在公立三级医院和高流量HIV诊所中收集数据,统计分析包括卡方检验、逻辑回归分析和Kruskal-Wallis检验,以评估相关性。
elements_zh.main_results: 仅有32.1%(80/249)的照顾者听说过HPV,更少的人了解其与宫颈癌(24.4%,60/246)或预防方法(31.9%,79/248)之间的关联。存在普遍的误解,其中16.3%(36/221)的照顾者错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系起来,而61.1%(44/72)不愿接种疫苗的照顾者则表示对疫苗有效性的不信任。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究揭示了显著的知识与行动之间的差距,尽管受过高等教育的照顾者具有最高的知识水平(45.5%,p < 0.001),但他们的疫苗接种意愿(50%,33/66)与受教育程度较低的群体相似,表明知识本身并不足以转化为行动。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了需要进行文化定制的教育以消除误解并提高疫苗接种率,同时也支持将HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌筛查整合到HIV治疗服务中的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 结构性障碍,如对疫苗的不了解和错过学校安排的疫苗接种日,较为突出,且由于研究采用横断面设计,可能存在自我报告偏差,因此证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 目的:评估塞拉利昂接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的认知、意愿及其障碍。方法:本横断面研究在塞拉利昂的公立三级医院和高流量HIV诊所中,通过结构化问卷调查了249名照顾者对HPV的认知、意愿及其障碍。数据通过卡方检验、逻辑回归分析和Kruskal-Wallis检验进行统计分析,以评估相关性。结果:仅有32.1%(80/249)的照顾者听说过HPV,更少的人了解其与宫颈癌(24.4%,60/246)或预防方法(31.9%,79/248)之间的关联。存在普遍的误解,其中16.3%(36/221)的照顾者错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系起来,而61.1%(44/72)不愿接种疫苗的照顾者则表示对疫苗有效性的不信任。尽管受过高等教育的照顾者表现出最高的知识水平(45.5%,p < 0.001),但他们的疫苗接种意愿(50%,33/66)与受教育程度较低的群体相似,凸显了知识与行动之间的差距。结构性障碍占主导地位,其中66.1%(154/233)的照顾者表示不了解疫苗,10.3%(24/233)错过了学校安排的疫苗接种日。关系动态显著影响了疫苗接种意愿:扩展家庭成员表现出最高的意愿(69.4%,p = 0.029),而祖父母则意愿最低(31%,9/29)。尽管系统性障碍如疫苗接种服务中断、疫苗供应和冷链限制了疫苗接种率,但医疗工作者作为信息来源被证明是最有效的(秩和 = 889.5,p = 0.039)。结论:本研究强调了需要进行文化定制的教育以消除误解,并采用社区驱动的策略,通过医疗工作者和扩展家庭等值得信赖的行动者来提高疫苗接种率。本研究支持将HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌筛查整合到HIV治疗服务中的必要性。

title: HPV-Associated Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Persistent Oral High-Risk HPV Detection: A Narrative Review of Longitudinal Assessment, Diagnostic Evaluation, and Surveillance
abstract: Currently, no validated population-based screening strategy uses persistent oral high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) detection to identify individuals at clinically meaningful risk of HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). This narrative review evaluates sampling strategies, virologic assays, liquid-biopsy biomarkers, adjunct biomarkers, and integrative approaches across three clinical contexts: longitudinal oral HPV assessment; diagnostic evaluation and HPV attribution in suspected or newly diagnosed OPSCC; and treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC. The literature published from January 2020 through June 2026 and identified in PubMed was synthesized by clinical context, specimen source, biological target, study population, and intended use. Repeated detection of the same high-risk HPV genotype in serial oral specimens provides a pragmatic measure of persistent oral HPV detection but does not establish uninterrupted infection, sustained viral oncogene transcription, malignant transformation, or future OPSCC risk. Oral HPV DNA, oral E6/E7 mRNA, tumor-tissue HPV testing, and plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA represent distinct biological and clinical signals. Plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA has the most mature evidence for treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC, not population screening. Clinical translation requires standardized longitudinal protocols, validation in intended-use populations, actionable management pathways, and incremental predictive value for proposed risk-stratification models.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review focuses on the role of persistent oral high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) detection in identifying individuals at risk for HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). The review synthesizes evidence from studies published between January 2020 and June 2026, sourced from PubMed, and categorizes findings by clinical context, specimen source, and intended use. It highlights that repeated detection of the same HPV genotype in oral specimens is a practical measure but does not confirm uninterrupted infection or future cancer risk. The review also notes that different HPV detection methods, such as oral HPV DNA, E6/E7 mRNA, tumor-tissue testing, and plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA, provide distinct biological and clinical signals. Finally, it emphasizes the need for standardized protocols, validation in target populations, and actionable pathways for clinical translation.

title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒相关口咽部鳞状细胞癌与持续性口腔高危型HPV检测:关于纵向评估、诊断评估及监测的叙述性综述
source_body_en: Currently, no validated population-based screening strategy uses persistent oral high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) detection to identify individuals at clinically meaningful risk of HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). This narrative review evaluates sampling strategies, virologic assays, liquid-biopsy biomarkers, adjunct biomarkers, and integrative approaches across three clinical contexts: longitudinal oral HPV assessment; diagnostic evaluation and HPV attribution in suspected or newly diagnosed OPSCC; and treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC. The literature published from January 2020 through June 2026 and identified in PubMed was synthesized by clinical context, specimen source, biological target, study population, and intended use. Repeated detection of the same high-risk HPV genotype in serial oral specimens provides a pragmatic measure of persistent oral HPV detection but does not establish uninterrupted infection, sustained viral oncogene transcription, malignant transformation, or future OPSCC risk. Oral HPV DNA, oral E6/E7 mRNA, tumor-tissue HPV testing, and plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA represent distinct biological and clinical signals. Plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA has the most mature evidence for treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC, not population screening. Clinical translation requires standardized longitudinal protocols, validation in intended-use populations, actionable management pathways, and incremental predictive value for proposed risk-stratification models.
abstract_zh: 目前,尚无经过验证的基于人群的筛查策略利用持续性口腔高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)检测来识别具有临床显著风险的人乳头瘤病毒相关口咽部鳞状细胞癌(OPSCC)的个体。本叙述性综述评估了三种临床情境下的采样策略、病毒学检测方法、液体活检生物标志物、辅助生物标志物及整合方法:纵向口腔HPV评估;疑似或新诊断OPSCC中的诊断评估和HPV归因;以及在已确诊的人乳头瘤病毒相关OPSCC中治疗监测和术后监测。从2020年1月至2026年6月在PubMed中发表的文献被按临床情境、样本来源、生物靶标、研究人群和预期用途进行综合分析。在连续的口腔样本中重复检测到相同的高危型HPV基因型可作为持续性口腔HPV检测的实用指标,但不能证明持续感染、病毒癌基因持续转录、恶性转化或未来OPSCC风险。口腔HPV DNA、口腔E6/E7 mRNA、肿瘤组织HPV检测和血浆循环肿瘤HPV DNA代表不同的生物和临床信号。血浆循环肿瘤HPV DNA在已确诊的人乳头瘤病毒相关OPSCC中治疗监测和术后监测方面具有最成熟的证据,但不适用于人群筛查。临床转化需要标准化的纵向协议、在预期用途人群中进行验证、可操作的管理路径以及对拟议风险分层模型的增量预测价值。

title: Phosphorylated HPV‐16 E7 disrupts planar cell polarity in cervical cancer cells through vangl1 dysregulation.
abstract: High‐risk (HR) human papillomaviruses (HPVs) rely on the continuous expression of the E6 and E7 oncoproteins to reshape epithelial biology, drive and sustain malignant transformation. The high‐risk E7 oncoprotein is multifunctional, and its phosphorylation by Casein Kinase II (CKII) is a key post translational modification that amplifies its oncogenic potential. Therefore, it is important to extensively delineate the consequences of E7 phosphorylation on HPV-driven transformation and malignant progression. Here, we identify Vangl1, a core planar cell polarity (PCP) scaffold protein, as a novel, phosphorylation‐dependent interactor of HPV‐16 E7. Through proteomics, biochemical and cell-based assays, this study established that CKII‐mediated phosphorylation is required for Vangl1 recruitment, and that this interaction is more pronounced with HPV‐16 E7, revealing a new mechanism by which HR HPVs might disrupt epithelial organization. In CaSki cells and ectopic expression models, E7 expression profoundly disrupts Vangl1 homeostasis, creating a biphasic proteostatic imbalance in which phosphorylated Vangl1 is aberrantly stabilised. This retention parallels E7 stability, revealing a reciprocal oncogenic stabilization. Furthermore, we found that Vangl1 is depleted in cytoskeletal cell fractions in the presence of E7, and that E7 translocates to membrane compartments where it colocalizes with Vangl1. In line with this, we identified that this abnormal Vangl1 stabilization occurs from its mislocalization and impaired trafficking arising from E7's interference with the Adaptor-Related Protein Complex 1 Subunit Mu 1 (AP1M1). Functionally, Vangl1 siRNA-mediated ablation in CaSki spheroids mirrors E6/E7 loss, leading to disrupted spheroidal architecture, reduced invasion, and increased sensitivity to chemotherapeutic stress. title_zh: 磷酸化的人乳头瘤病毒HPV-16 E7通过vangl1调控失调破坏宫颈癌细胞的平面细胞极性。
source_body_en: High‐risk (HR) human papillomaviruses (HPVs) rely on the continuous expression of the E6 and E7 oncoproteins to reshape epithelial biology, drive and sustain malignant transformation. The high‐risk E7 oncoprotein is multifunctional, and its phosphorylation by Casein Kinase II (CKII) is a key post translational modification that amplifies its oncogenic potential. Therefore, it is important to extensively delineate the consequences of E7 phosphorylation on HPV-driven transformation and malignant progression. Here, we identify Vangl1, a core planar cell polarity (PCP) scaffold protein, as a novel, phosphorylation‐dependent interactor of HPV‐16 E7. Through proteomics, biochemical and cell-based assays, this study established that CKII‐mediated phosphorylation is required for Vangl1 recruitment, and that this interaction is more pronounced with HPV‐16 E7, revealing a new mechanism by which HR HPVs might disrupt epithelial organization. In CaSki cells and ectopic expression models, E7 expression profoundly disrupts Vangl1 homeostasis, creating a biphasic proteostatic imbalance in which phosphorylated Vangl1 is aberrantly stabilised. This retention parallels E7 stability, revealing a reciprocal oncogenic stabilization. Furthermore, we found that Vangl1 is depleted in cytoskeletal cell fractions in the presence of E7, and that E7 translocates to membrane compartments where it colocalizes with Vangl1. In line with this, we identified that this abnormal Vangl1 stabilization occurs from its mislocalization and impaired trafficking arising from E7's interference with the Adaptor-Related Protein Complex 1 Subunit Mu 1 (AP1M1). Functionally, Vangl1 siRNA-mediated ablation in CaSki spheroids mirrors E6/E7 loss, leading to disrupted spheroidal architecture, reduced invasion, and increased sensitivity to chemotherapeutic stress. These phenotypes position Vangl1 as a key downstream effector through which E7 reshaped epithelial behaviour. Taken together, our findings reveal a CKII-dependent mechanism by which HPV-16 E7 hijacks a core planar polarity component to destabilize epithelial structure and promote malignant traits; thus, positioning Vangl1 as a potential druggable target in HPV-associated cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: 高危型(HR)人乳头瘤病毒(HPVs)依赖于E6和E7癌蛋白的持续表达来重塑上皮生物学,驱动并维持恶性转化。高危型E7癌蛋白具有多种功能,其由酪蛋白激酶II(CKII)介导的磷酸化是关键的翻译后修饰,增强了其致癌潜能。因此,有必要全面阐明E7磷酸化对HPV驱动的转化和恶性进展的影响。本研究发现,Vangl1是一种核心的平面细胞极性(PCP)支架蛋白,是HPV-16 E7的一种新型、依赖磷酸化的相互作用蛋白。通过蛋白质组学、生化和细胞实验,本研究证实CKII介导的磷酸化对于Vangl1的招募是必需的,并且这种相互作用在HPV-16 E7中更为显著,揭示了高危型HPVs可能通过干扰上皮组织结构的新机制。在CaSki细胞和异位表达模型中,E7的表达显著破坏了Vangl1的稳态,导致双相的蛋白质稳态失衡,其中磷酸化的Vangl1异常稳定。这种保留与E7的稳定性相呼应,揭示了一种相互依赖的致癌性稳定机制。此外,我们发现,在E7存在的情况下,Vangl1在细胞骨架部分被耗尽,并且E7会转移到膜区室,与Vangl1共定位。与此一致,我们发现这种异常的Vangl1稳定化源于E7对适配蛋白相关蛋白复合体1亚基Mu 1(AP1M1)的干扰所导致的Vangl1定位异常和运输受损。功能上,Vangl1 siRNA介导的敲除在CaSki球体中模拟了E6/E7的缺失,导致球体结构破坏、侵袭性降低以及对化疗压力的敏感性增加。这些表型表明Vangl1是E7重塑上皮行为的关键下游效应因子。综上所述,我们的研究揭示了HPV-16 E7通过CKII依赖机制劫持核心平面极性成分,从而破坏上皮结构并促进恶性特征;因此,将Vangl1定位为HPV相关宫颈癌的潜在可药靶点。

title: Real-world safety data of human papillomavirus vaccines after marketing in Shandong, China, August 2017–October 2025
abstract: After the Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine was listed for use in China in 2017, it has proven to be a safe and cost-effective method for preventing HPV infection. With the increase in vaccination volume, its safety is becoming increasingly important. The safety data from post-marketing can enhance public confidence in vaccines. We collected adverse events following immunization (AEFI) through the Chinese National AEFI Information Management System (CNAEFIs) between August 2017 and October 2025. Vaccination data from the same period were obtained via the Shandong Provincial Immunization Program Information Systems (SDIPIs). A Univariate Poisson regression model was used to explore risk factors associated with HPV vaccine AEFI. Disproportionality analysis was performed to detect abnormal signals related to the HPV vaccine. From August 2017 to October 2025 in Shandong, CNAEFIs received 1056 AEFI cases, with an overall reporting AEFI rate of 7.99 per 100,000 doses. 1008 cases (95.46%) were mild vaccine-related reactions, and 15 cases (1.42%) were rare adverse reactions. Myalgia, induration with a diameter greater than 5 cm, immune thrombocytopenia, and mild reactions such as fatigue, drowsiness, dizziness, and headache were detected as abnormal signals. The reporting AEFI rate of the HPV vaccine in Shandong was low, and the majority of AEFIs were mild cases. The safety profile in post-marketing was good.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the safety of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines after their introduction in China, addressing the growing need to ensure their safety as vaccination volumes increased.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A real-world safety study was conducted in Shandong, China, between August 2017 and October 2025, utilizing data from the Chinese National AEFI Information Management System (CNAEFIs) and the Shandong Provincial Immunization Program Information Systems (SDIPIs).
analysis.methods: A Univariate Poisson regression model was used to explore risk factors associated with HPV vaccine adverse events following immunization (AEFI), and disproportionality analysis was performed to detect abnormal signals.
analysis.main_results: From August 2017 to October 2025, 1056 AEFI cases were reported, with an overall rate of 7.99 per 100,000 doses. Of these, 1008 cases (95.46%) were mild vaccine-related reactions, and 15 cases (1.42%) were rare adverse reactions. Myalgia, induration with a diameter greater than 5 cm, immune thrombocytopenia, and mild reactions such as fatigue, drowsiness, dizziness, and headache were detected as abnormal signals.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating a low reporting rate of AEFI and a predominantly mild safety profile for the HPV vaccine, which is a novel observation in the context of real-world post-marketing data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies by reinforcing the safety of HPV vaccines and supporting continued vaccination programs to prevent HPV-associated diseases such as cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on passive reporting systems, which may underrepresent rare adverse events, and the evidence is moderate in strength due to the observational nature of the data.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the safety of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines in Shandong, China, from August 2017 to October 2025. It highlights the importance of monitoring vaccine safety as usage increases, utilizing post-marketing data from national and provincial systems. The results show a low overall adverse event reporting rate, with most cases being mild. The authors interpret these findings as indicating a good safety profile for the HPV vaccine, which has implications for public health and vaccination programs. However, the study's reliance on passive reporting systems limits the confidence in its conclusions, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

title: Knowledge of Human Papillomavirus and Willingness to Recommend HPV Vaccination for Young Girls Among Doctors in Peshawar: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Abstract Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer, which remains an important public health problem in low- and middle-income countries. HPV vaccination is an effective strategy for preventing HPV-related disease, but vaccine uptake in Pakistan remains limited. Healthcare providers can play an important role in communicating the benefits of HPV vaccination and recommending vaccination to eligible adolescents. As Khyber Pakhtunkhwa prepares for HPV vaccine implementation, assessing physicians' knowledge and willingness to recommend vaccination is important. This study aimed to assess HPV-related knowledge and willingness to recommend HPV vaccination among doctors in Peshawar, Pakistan. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from August 2025 to January 2026 among 189 registered doctors in public sector hospitals in Peshawar. Participants completed a structured, self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and willingness to recommend the vaccine. Knowledge scores were categorised as good, moderate, or poor. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, tests of association, and multivariable binary logistic regression. Adjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were reported. Results: The mean knowledge score was 12.71 ± 3.01, and 121 participants (64.0%) had good knowledge. Overall, 144 participants (76.2%) reported willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Doctors who had received formal HPV training had higher mean knowledge scores than those without prior training (13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17; p Conclusion: Most doctors in Peshawar demonstrated good HPV-related knowledge and reported a high willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Higher HPV knowledge was associated with greater adjusted odds of willingness to recommend vaccination, although the overall multivariable model had limited explanatory power. Strengthening HPV-related education, together with clear clinical and implementation guidance, may support physicians in communicating HPV vaccination to eligible adolescents as vaccination programmes expand in Pakistan.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed HPV-related knowledge and willingness to recommend vaccination among doctors in Peshawar, Pakistan. title_zh: 白沙瓦医生对人乳头瘤病毒知识及其推荐HPV 疫苗接种给年轻女孩的意愿:横断面研究
source_body_en: Abstract Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer, which remains an important public health problem in low- and middle-income countries. HPV vaccination is an effective strategy for preventing HPV-related disease, but vaccine uptake in Pakistan remains limited. Healthcare providers can play an important role in communicating the benefits of HPV vaccination and recommending vaccination to eligible adolescents. As Khyber Pakhtunkhwa prepares for HPV vaccine implementation, assessing physicians' knowledge and willingness to recommend vaccination is important. This study aimed to assess HPV-related knowledge and willingness to recommend HPV vaccination among doctors in Peshawar, Pakistan. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from August 2025 to January 2026 among 189 registered doctors in public sector hospitals in Peshawar. Participants completed a structured, self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and willingness to recommend the vaccine. Knowledge scores were categorised as good, moderate, or poor. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, tests of association, and multivariable binary logistic regression. Adjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were reported. Results: The mean knowledge score was 12.71 ± 3.01, and 121 participants (64.0%) had good knowledge. Overall, 144 participants (76.2%) reported willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Doctors who had received formal HPV training had higher mean knowledge scores than those without prior training (13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17; p Conclusion: Most doctors in Peshawar demonstrated good HPV-related knowledge and reported a high willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Higher HPV knowledge was associated with greater adjusted odds of willingness to recommend vaccination, although the overall multivariable model had limited explanatory power. Strengthening HPV-related education, together with clear clinical and implementation guidance, may support physicians in communicating HPV vaccination to eligible adolescents as vaccination programmes expand in Pakistan.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景:人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染是导致宫颈癌的主要原因,这在低收入和中等收入国家仍然是重要的公共卫生问题。HPV 疫苗接种是预防HPV相关疾病的有效策略,但在巴基斯坦,疫苗的接种率仍然有限。医疗保健提供者在向适龄青少年传播HPV 疫苗接种的益处和推荐该疫苗方面可以发挥重要作用。随着开伯尔-普什图省准备实施HPV 疫苗,评估医生对HPV相关知识及其推荐意愿具有重要意义。本研究旨在评估巴基斯坦白沙瓦医生对HPV相关知识及其推荐HPV 疫苗接种的意愿。方法:本研究是一项基于医院的横断面研究,于2025年8月至2026年1月期间在白沙瓦的公立医疗机构中对189名注册医生进行。参与者完成了评估社会人口学特征、HPV感染及疫苗接种知识,以及推荐疫苗意愿的结构化、自我管理问卷。知识得分被分为良好、中等和较差三类。数据通过描述性统计、关联性检验和多变量二元逻辑回归进行分析。报告了调整后的比值比(ORs)及其95%置信区间(CIs)。结果:平均知识得分为12.71 ± 3.01,其中121名参与者(64.0%)具有良好的知识。总体而言,144名参与者(76.2%)表示愿意推荐HPV 疫苗接种。接受过正式HPV培训的医生平均知识得分高于未接受过培训的医生(13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17;p < 0.001)。报告了调整后的比值比(ORs)及其95%置信区间(CIs)。解释与创新性:尽管整体多变量模型的解释力有限,但HPV知识水平较高与推荐疫苗接种的调整后比值比更高相关。白沙瓦的大多数医生展示了良好的HPV相关知识,并表示有较高的意愿推荐HPV 疫苗接种。科学与公共卫生意义:加强HPV相关教育,结合明确的临床和实施指导,可能有助于医生在巴基斯坦扩大疫苗接种项目时向适龄青少年传播该疫苗的信息。局限性与证据强度:整体多变量模型的解释力有限,且本研究仅在单一城市进行,这可能限制其推广性。

title: Factors influencing human papillomavirus school-based immunization in Alberta: a qualitative inquiry
abstract: Abstract Objectives While human papillomavirus (HPV) infections and associated cancers are preventable through immunization, vaccine coverage for school-aged boys and girls remains suboptimal in Alberta and across Canada. To reconcile this coverage gap and inform Alberta’s school-based HPV immunization program, this study looks to understand barriers and enablers of immunization, how they vary across health zones and population groups, and summarize recommendations to overcome these barriers. Methods Virtual interviews were conducted with members of the Healthier Together Panel of Albertans who were parents/guardians of school-aged children (11–17 years old). Program stakeholders (e.g., leaders, front-line workers) were separately invited to participate in virtual focus groups. Development of study materials and data analysis were guided by the Conceptual Framework of Access to Health Care. Template thematic analysis was used to analyze the interview and focus group data. Results Enablers of HPV immunization included convenience of the school-based program, normalization of the vaccine alongside other routine vaccines, relationship building with schools, parents/guardians, and communities, messaging that included personal stories, and youth engagement. Barriers included gaps in HPV knowledge, perceived lack of trust and transparency, links to sexual activity, consent processes, language barriers, and immunization anxiety. Key recommendations included addressing gaps in HPV messaging, changing the method of program material distribution, employing strategies to reduce immunization anxiety, and continuing to build relationships with parents/guardians, schools, and communities. Conclusion A need to improve HPV messaging to address knowledge gaps and misconceptions was identified. Future work could consider perspectives from other providers, including family physicians and pharmacists.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand barriers and enablers of human papillomavirus (HPV) immunization in Alberta, as vaccine coverage remains suboptimal despite the preventable nature of HPV infections and associated cancers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This qualitative inquiry involved virtual interviews with parents/guardians of school-aged children (11–17 years old) and virtual focus groups with program stakeholders, including leaders and front-line workers, across Alberta's health zones.
analysis.methods: The study used virtual interviews and focus groups, with data analysis guided by the Conceptual Framework of Access to Health Care and template thematic analysis.
analysis.main_results: Enablers of HPV immunization included convenience of the school-based program, normalization of the vaccine alongside other routine vaccines, relationship building with schools, parents/guardians, and communities, messaging that included personal stories, and youth engagement.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the need to improve HPV messaging to address knowledge gaps and misconceptions, which is a novel insight for enhancing immunization programs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform strategies to improve HPV immunization programs by addressing knowledge gaps, enhancing communication, and fostering community engagement.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to qualitative data from virtual interviews and focus groups, and the evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of quantitative measures and potential biases in self-reported data.

analysis.summary_en: This qualitative study explores barriers and enablers of human papillomavirus (HPV) immunization in Alberta's school-based program. The research aimed to address suboptimal vaccine coverage by understanding factors influencing uptake across health zones and population groups. Virtual interviews with parents/guardians and focus groups with program stakeholders were conducted, guided by the Conceptual Framework of Access to Health Care. Results identified enablers such as convenience, normalization with other vaccines, relationship building, and youth engagement, alongside barriers like knowledge gaps and immunization anxiety. The authors concluded that improving HPV messaging is crucial to address misconceptions. The study's findings can inform public health strategies to enhance immunization programs. However, the qualitative nature of the data and potential biases limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 尽管人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒)感染及其相关癌症可通过疫苗接种预防,但阿尔伯塔省及加拿大其他地区针对学龄男孩和女孩的疫苗接种率仍不理想。为弥合这一接种差距并为阿尔伯塔省的学校为基础的HPV疫苗接种计划提供信息,本研究旨在了解疫苗接种的障碍和促进因素,这些因素在不同健康区和人口群体中的差异,以及总结克服这些障碍的建议。方法 与阿尔伯塔省健康者共同参与的Healthier Together小组成员进行了虚拟访谈,这些成员是学龄儿童(11-17岁)的父母或监护人。另外,还邀请了计划相关利益相关者(如领导者和一线工作人员)参加虚拟焦点小组。研究材料的开发和数据分析由健康护理可及性概念框架指导。使用模板主题分析法对访谈和焦点小组数据进行分析。结果 HPV疫苗接种的促进因素包括学校为基础的计划的便利性、将疫苗与其他常规疫苗一同推广、与学校、父母/监护人和社区建立关系、包含个人故事的信息传播以及青少年参与。障碍包括对HPV知识的缺乏、对信任和透明度的感知缺失、与性活动的关联、接种同意流程、语言障碍以及接种焦虑。关键建议包括改善HPV信息传播以解决知识差距和误解、改变计划材料的分发方式、采用减少接种焦虑的策略,以及继续与父母/监护人、学校和社区建立关系。结论 识别出需要改善HPV信息传播以解决知识差距和误解。未来的工作可以考虑其他提供者的视角,包括家庭医生和药剂师。

title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS GENOTYPE DISTRIBUTION AMONG ADULT WOMEN IN THE RABAT REGION (MOROCCO): A RETROSPECTIVE AND ANALYTICAL STUDY WITH IMPLICATIONS FOR HPV VACCINATION STRATEGIES.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer (CC) remains a major public health challenge in Morocco, where it is the second most frequent cancer among women. Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary etiological factor. Limited data exist regarding HPV genotype distribution and associated risk factors in the Moroccan female population. METHODS: A retrospective, descriptive, and analytical study was conducted at the Mohammed V Military Teaching Hospital, Rabat, Morocco, between May 2023 and April 2025. Asymptomatic women aged 30-65 years undergoing routine CC screening were included. Cervical samples were collected using liquid-based cytology medium and analyzed for HR-HPV using the Cobas® 4800 assay. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV (excluding HPV16/18) underwent extended genotyping using the HPV002® assay. Sociodemographic, behavioral, and clinical data were collected via standardized questionnaires. Statistical analysis included prevalence estimates, univariate, and multivariate logistic regression to identify factors independently associated with HR-HPV infection. RESULTS: Of 2.235 eligible women, HR-HPV prevalence was 5.5% (n=123). HPV16 was the most prevalent genotype (19.5%), followed by HPV68 (12.2%), HPV31 (9.8%), HPV33 (7.3%), HPV35 (7.3%), and HPV39 (7.3%). Single-genotype infections predominated (95%), with dual infections in 5% of cases. Genotypes targeted by the 9-valent HPV vaccine accounted for 58.5% of infections. Multivariate analysis identified diabetes/immunosuppression, hormonal contraceptive use, and inflammatory cervical abnormalities as independent predictors of HR-HPV infection. 75% of HR-HPV-positive women were over 40 years, with a peak prevalence in the 50-59 age group. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first detailed characterization of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in Moroccan women attending a tertiary hospital. HPV16 remains the predominant genotype. A significant proportion of infections are preventable by the 9-valent vaccine. These findings highlight the urgent need for expanded HPV vaccination and molecular-based screening programs in Morocco and provide a critical baseline for monitoring vaccine impact and guiding public health strategies.

source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer (CC) remains a major public health challenge in Morocco, where it is the second most frequent cancer among women. Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary etiological factor. Limited data exist regarding HPV genotype distribution and associated risk factors in the Moroccan female population. METHODS: A retrospective, descriptive, and analytical study was conducted at the Mohammed V Military Teaching Hospital, Rabat, Morocco, between May 2023 and April 2025. Asymptomatic women aged 30-65 years undergoing routine CC screening were included. Cervical samples were collected using liquid-based cytology medium and analyzed for HR-HPV using the Cobas® 4800 assay. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV (excluding HPV16/18) underwent extended genotyping using the HPV002® assay. Sociodemographic, behavioral, and clinical data were collected via standardized questionnaires. Statistical analysis included prevalence estimates, univariate, and multivariate logistic regression to identify factors independently associated with HR-HPV infection. RESULTS: Of 2.235 eligible women, HR-HPV prevalence was 5.5% (n=123). HPV16 was the most prevalent genotype (19.5%), followed by HPV68 (12.2%), HPV31 (9.8%), HPV33 (7.3%), HPV35 (7.3%), and HPV39 (7.3%). Single-genotype infections predominated (95%), with dual infections in 5% of cases. Genotypes targeted by the 9-valent HPV vaccine accounted for 58.5% of infections. Multivariate analysis identified diabetes/immunosuppression, hormonal contraceptive use, and inflammatory cervical abnormalities as independent predictors of HR-HPV infection. 75% of HR-HPV-positive women were over 40 years, with a peak prevalence in the 50-59 age group. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first detailed characterization of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in Moroccan women attending a tertiary hospital. HPV16 remains the predominant genotype. A significant proportion of infections are preventable by the 9-valent vaccine. These findings highlight the urgent need for expanded HPV vaccination and molecular-based screening programs in Morocco and provide a critical baseline for monitoring vaccine impact and guiding public health strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the distribution of human papillomavirus (HPV) genotypes among adult women in the Rabat region of Morocco, focusing on high-risk HPV types associated with cervical cancer. Conducted at the Mohammed V Military Teaching Hospital between May 2023 and April 2025, the retrospective analysis included asymptomatic women aged 30-65 undergoing routine cervical cancer screening. HPV genotypes were identified using the Cobas® 4800 assay, with extended genotyping for positive samples excluding HPV16/18. The study found that HPV16 was the most prevalent genotype, followed by HPV68, HPV31, HPV33, HPV35, and HPV39. Single-genotype infections were common, and genotypes targeted by the 9-valent vaccine accounted for 58.5% of infections. Multivariate analysis identified diabetes/immunosuppression, hormonal contraceptive use, and inflammatory cervical abnormalities as independent predictors of HR-HPV infection. The findings suggest the need for expanded HPV vaccination and screening programs in Morocco to address the prevalent genotypes and associated risk factors.

title_zh: 拉巴特地区成年女性中人乳头瘤病毒基因型分布:一项回顾性与分析性研究及其对HPV 疫苗接种策略的影响
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer (CC) remains a major public health challenge in Morocco, where it is the second most frequent cancer among women. Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary etiological factor. Limited data exist regarding HPV genotype distribution and associated risk factors in the Moroccan female population. METHODS: A retrospective, descriptive, and analytical study was conducted at the Mohammed V Military Teaching Hospital, Rabat, Morocco, between May 2023 and April 2025. Asymptomatic women aged 30-65 years undergoing routine CC screening were included. Cervical samples were collected using liquid-based cytology medium and analyzed for HR-HPV using the Cobas® 4800 assay. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV (excluding HPV16/18) underwent extended genotyping using the HPV002® assay. Sociodemographic, behavioral, and clinical data were collected via standardized questionnaires. Statistical analysis included prevalence estimates, univariate, and multivariate logistic regression to identify factors independently associated with HR-HPV infection. RESULTS: Of 2.235 eligible women, HR-HPV prevalence was 5.5% (n=123). HPV16 was the most prevalent genotype (19.5%), followed by HPV68 (12.2%), HPV31 (9.8%), HPV33 (7.3%), HPV35 (7.3%), and HPV39 (7.3%). Single-genotype infections predominated (95%), with dual infections in 5% of cases. Genotypes targeted by the 9-valent HPV vaccine accounted for 58.5% of infections. Multivariate analysis identified diabetes/immunosuppression, hormonal contraceptive use, and inflammatory cervical abnormalities as independent predictors of HR-HPV infection. 75% of HR-HPV-positive women were over 40 years, with a peak prevalence in the 50-59 age group. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first detailed characterization of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in Moroccan women attending a tertiary hospital. HPV16 remains the predominant genotype. A significant proportion of infections are preventable by the 9-valent vaccine. These findings highlight the urgent need for expanded HPV vaccination and molecular-based screening programs in Morocco and provide a critical baseline for monitoring vaccine impact and guiding public health strategies.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 宫颈癌(CC)仍然是摩洛哥的主要公共卫生挑战,其中它是女性中第二常见的癌症。持续感染高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)是主要的病因因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在摩洛哥拉巴特的Mohammed V军事教学医院,于2023年5月至2025年4月期间进行了一项回顾性、描述性和分析性研究。纳入了30至65岁接受常规宫颈癌筛查的无症状女性。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用液基细胞学介质收集宫颈样本,并通过Cobas® 4800检测分析HR-HPV。对于检测出的非HPV16/18的混合HR-HPV阳性样本,采用HPV002®检测进行扩展基因型分析。通过标准化问卷收集社会人口学、行为和临床数据。统计分析包括患病率估计、单变量和多变量逻辑回归,以确定与HR-HPV感染独立相关的因素。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究首次详细描述了摩洛哥三级医院就诊女性中HR-HPV的患病率和基因型分布。HPV16仍然是主要的基因型。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在摩洛哥扩大HPV 疫苗接种和基于分子的筛查计划的迫切需求,并为监测疫苗的影响和指导公共卫生策略提供了关键的基线数据。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究设计的具体局限性。

title: Beyond cervicovaginal limitations: potential bidirectional interactions between HPV infection and mucosal microbiota from oral, anorectal and penile sites — a mini-review
abstract: Most existing studies focusing on human papillomavirus (HPV)-microbiota interactions are confined to the cervicovaginal tract, while mucosal microecological crosstalk at oral, anorectal and penile sites remains insufficiently summarized. This mini-review provides a narrative synthesis of current sequencing and epidemiological evidence regarding potential bidirectional interactions between HPV infection and site-specific mucosal microbiota across extra-cervicovaginal niches in both males and females. Oral HPV reshapes microbial composition in a sex-, race- and population-dependent manner; periodontal dysbiosis, high-risk HPV and Candida albicans jointly form a tripartite oncogenic axis that may contribute to oral squamous cell carcinoma, and periodontal inflammation independently elevates oral HPV susceptibility. Among men who have sex with men, pro-inflammatory anaerobes such as Bacteroides fragilis and Sneathia accumulate in anorectal HPV-related lesions, and concurrent HIV or sexually transmitted bacterial co-infections worsen mucosal dysbiosis and viral persistence. On penile skin, Corynebacterium is associated with a lower prevalence of HPV, whereas anaerobe-dominant community state types increase high-risk HPV risk, with HIV-induced baseline dysbiosis masking HPV-specific penile microbial signatures. Collectively, tissue-specific mucosal dysbiosis may represent an important co-factor linked to persistent HPV infection and subsequent malignant transformation. This review offsets long-standing sex-related and anatomical research bias, clarifies multi-site host-virus-microbe mechanisms, and provides theoretical support for developing microbiota-based biomarkers and microecological interventions to prevent non-cervical HPV-associated malignancies.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology
